text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's♪ Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now, let us be on our way!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, that's a surprise for when we 
arrive♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day. For some reason, out of 
nowhere, Satono Diamond dragged me out 
somewhere. The place we arrived at was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nothing seemed amiss in front of the Ritto 
Dorm. Except for an unfamiliar machine 
sitting right in front of the entrance 
with a heavy thud.
choice_data_list:
What are those cranes and mountains of 
boxes!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehe, it's a Valentine's surprise!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared a giant crane game just for 
you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The rules are the same as a regular crane 
game. While suspended from that crane, you 
will grab the prize yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it seems to be the kind of 
game where you act as the crane arm 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Since it's Valentine's Day, I thought a 
surprise would be fun, so I did a bunch of 
research.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"And then, I found an article about an 
event held by a Satono Group affiliate 
featuring a giant crane game!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"It looked so fascinating that I went and 
borrowed some equipment and staff 
members♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The prizes are Valentine's Day chocolates! 
We have a wide variety prepared, so please 
take whatever catches your eye!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We have a wide variety available, from 
simple cheap chocolates to limited-edition 
treats from renowned chocolatiers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just tell us which direction you want to 
go, and our staff will operate the crane 
for you♪
choice_data_list: Could the one acting as the claw be...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, Trainer-san! Please enjoy 
this special Valentine's gift from Dia!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...That idea is just like the endlessly 
curious Satono Diamond. As her Trainer, I 
have to steel my resolve...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san~! Please tell me which 
direction you want to move~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okaaay! Now, lower it down slowly, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a crane operator with such 
expertise. Thanks to their careful 
handling, I was lowered onto the mountain 
of chocolates without a single worry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Actually, this is getting really fun! I 
scoop up the nearby chocolates and hold 
them in my arms.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wah! You're so good at this, Trainer! That 
sense of balance... Impressive as always!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, going for another one!? Do your 
best not to drop it...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you seem completely absorbed in it. 
I'm so glad you're having fun♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, that was wonderful! I was 
completely enchanted!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Besides... hehehe, they look like they're 
having so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm so happy...♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Fun things outside of racing, too... It'd 
be nice if we could share them together 
like this, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, chocolates! Please, help yourself!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
When I get home, I think I'll eat some 
chocolate while looking back on today as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All the chocolates won from the crane 
game. With every bite taken day by day, 
I'm sure it'll bring a smile to mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Actually, this is getting really fun! I 
gather up the chocolates within arm's 
reach.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah...! That chocolate is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was one piece of chocolate whose 
wrapping was slightly crooked. Losing my 
balance, I reach out toward that somewhat 
handmade-looking treat.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer! Please don't push yourself too 
hard...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I ended up dropping the other 
chocolates I worked so hard to get..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be they noticed...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The haul from the giant crane game was 
fantastic. Above all, I managed to get 
that slightly misshapen wrapped 
chocolate!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Those... are chocolates that I made.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So you realized it was handmade and chose 
it for me after all...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Jeez...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, here you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I opened the wrapping and popped one of 
the neatly arranged chocolates into my 
mouth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...What is this? Such a mysterious 
flavor. It's probably on the delicious 
side, but it's hard to describe."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It has kind of a subtle taste, doesn't 
it...?
choice_data_list:
It's delicious, but it has a strange 
taste...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That is correct. I attempted a rare 
flavor, but it ended up tasting rather 
peculiar...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I sampled it myself and it wasn't bad, 
but I honestly hesitated on whether it was 
fit to give to you..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for eating it! Please, 
that's already more than enough...!
choice_data_list:
Why don't we look for a flavor that goes 
well with this chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt like adding a little twist would 
make the chocolate even tastier. 
Therefore, I suggest adding a secret 
ingredient.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see... So we eat it together with fruit 
or sweets to find delicious combinations, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "That sounds fun! Let's do it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In search of combinations that make 
chocolate even more delicious, I try 
adding various little extras.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Satono Diamond's handmade 
chocolate turned out to be the perfect 
match for dragon fruit.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, this chocolate has a flavor truly 
unique to the world, crafted by you and 
me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's very delicious, but... I won't share 
this recipe with anyone. It's a secret 
between just the two of us♪
